deflect_linkage: Sarcastic delivery is a chatterbox render option for BENIGN /deflect (deflection_type OFF_TOPIC or NO_MATCH) when context allows playfulness. NEVER on unsafe/content-safety deflect or genuine confusion (use deescalating/calm). sarcastic is NOT a memory tone; memory /deflect returns clean text + a frozen-vocab tone, and chatterbox chooses the sarcastic render gated by deflection_type + relationship.
intensity_band_policy: Sarcasm INVERTS the usual ladder: risk of reading as mockery/passive-aggression RISES with intensity (RJ Starr; Psychology Today 2024). Low(1-3)/mid(4-7) dry sarcasm is fine; the bank TOPS OUT at ~7. HIGH intensity (8-10) must NOT escalate the sarcasm (cruelty cliff) -> PIVOT to a warm self-deprecating JOKE from the deflect-quip pool (self-deprecating humor raises warmth/approachability, Konig 2024). Use jokes sparingly; gate to benign deflect + established relationship; never on safety/confusion/genuine upset (humor-as-avoidance is the failure mode, Humor Health Project).
high_intensity_routes_to: deflect-quip pool (self-deprecating joke), not harder sarcasm
research: Konig et al 2024 self-deprecating humor warmth
